digest.component_or_area: capabilities - verdict tier and provenance signing
propositions: A run using a gateway/* provider (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) is stamped with tier: first_class even though no base_url is set, misrepresenting that it passed through an intermediary that can rewrite requests.

The tier derivation logic in capabilities.py checks only base_url presence, not whether the provider is a gateway, allowing gateway providers to be incorrectly marked first_class despite opaque intermediation.
Signed verdicts stamped first_class for gateway providers deceive attestation consumers about provenance trustworthiness when the request actually traversed a gateway capable of silent modification.
The fix applies set membership check against a registry of known gateway provider names to classify gateway providers as best_effort regardless of base_url.
endpoint_host remains None for gateway providers unless a base_url was explicitly configured, recording what was actually set rather than synthesizing a hostname from the provider id.
